title: Bologna Children’s Book Fair 2026
excerpt: Our third year with our own stand brought a new location in the international publishers’ hall and meetings with longstanding and new partners.
image_alt: The Epsilon Publishing Group team at our stand, Bologna Children’s Book Fair 2026
body:
[Our third year with our own stand](/news/bologna-childrens-book-fair-2025/) at the Bologna Children’s Book Fair, held on 13–16 April 2026, brought a new location in the international publishers’ hall and exciting developments for Epsilon Publishing Group.

Bologna greeted us with rain and colder weather than we were used to, but the colour and creativity of children’s books soon warmed our spirits. Our days were filled with meetings with longstanding partners and publishers we were meeting for the first time, sharing new titles and exploring possibilities for collaboration. Seeing familiar faces each year gives Bologna a welcome sense of continuity, while discovering how quickly a shared love of books can turn an introduction into a lively conversation remains one of its greatest pleasures. We left feeling increasingly at home in this international community, inspired by both the friendships we have nurtured and the connections just beginning.
